同一根梁，上面压，下面拉。: One beam: compressed on top, stretched below.
一根梁就能跨过去，桥上不用立塔。: A beam crosses the gap without towers above the deck.
跨度变大，弯曲迅速增加，需要更深的梁或更多桥墩。: Longer spans increase bending, requiring deeper beams or more piers.
红色在上，蓝色在下。这对力一起抵抗弯曲；粗细表示弯矩换算的力偶，不是整根梁的轴力: Red above, blue below: a force couple that resists bending. Width shows moment over beam depth, not axial force in the whole beam.
拱把重量往下送，也把两岸向外推。: An arch carries weight down and pushes the banks apart.
弯成一道拱，让压力沿拱圈走向两岸。: An arch carries compression along its curve to the banks.
两岸必须顶住向外的推力；偏载时，拱也会弯曲。: The banks must resist outward thrust. Uneven loading also bends the arch.
看拱脚向外的红箭头。地基既承受向下的重量，也必须抵抗水平推力。这里是无系杆三铰拱: Follow the outward red arrows: foundations resist horizontal thrust as well as weight. This is an untied three-hinged arch; a tied arch takes the thrust with a tie.
主缆受拉，把桥面挂起来。: The main cable is in tension. It hangs the deck.
吊杆把桥面挂到主缆上，主缆把荷载带到桥塔和锚碇。: Hangers suspend the deck from the main cables, which carry load to towers and anchorages.
两端要有牢固的锚碇，桥面还要抵抗风引起的摆动和扭转。: Strong anchorages hold the ends. The deck must also resist wind-driven sway and twist.
一根根斜索，直接拉到塔上。: Each stay pulls directly from the deck to the tower.
斜索直接拉住桥面，不需要一条跨过全桥的主缆。: Stays hold the deck directly, without a main cable across the bridge.
斜索同时把桥面向塔挤压；偏载还会让桥塔和基础承受弯矩。: Stays also compress the deck toward the tower. Uneven loads bend the tower and its foundation.
蓝色斜索受拉，红色桥面受压。本模型把桥面分成独立承载的小段；真实连续桥面会把荷载: Blue stays pull; the red deck is compressed. This model treats the deck as separate panels; a real continuous deck shares load among many stays.
理想静力模型 · 含桥面自重 · 流点表示传力路线，不是力的传播速度: Ideal statics · Includes deck weight · Dots show load paths, not propagation speed
蓝色主缆只能拉，不能推。桥塔受压；两端的锚碇还要把主缆牢牢拉住。移动卡车，看看哪: The blue main cable can only pull. Towers carry compression; end anchorages hold the cables. Move the truck and watch which side thickens. The cable shape shows equilibrium, not real deformation.
跨度越大，为什么要换桥型: Why longer spans change the bridge
在这组方案里，只剩悬索：主缆保持下垂，承担长跨。: In these schemes, only suspension remains: sagging cables carry the long span.
超过一千米，斜拉和悬索都还可行。: Beyond 1,000 m, cable-stayed and suspension bridges both remain possible.
桥越长，承重的方法也要跟着变。: As the gap grows, the way a bridge carries weight changes.
把弯矩交给梁；桥越长，梁就要越深。: A beam resists bending. A longer span needs a deeper beam.
梁高已封顶，弯矩仍随跨度的平方增长。: Beam depth is capped; bending still grows with the square of span.
让压力沿拱走向两岸，代价是坚实的拱座。: Compression follows the arch to banks that must resist its thrust.
拱肋越长越容易失稳，这组截面需要加大。: Longer arch ribs buckle more easily. This section must be enlarged.
斜索直接拉到塔上，也能跨过一千米。: Stays pull directly on the towers, even beyond 1,000 m.
塔高封顶后斜索变平，自重也占去拉力余量。: With tower height capped, stays flatten and their weight uses more tension capacity.
主缆保持下垂，用拉力承担长跨。: The main cable keeps its sag and carries long spans in tension.
主缆截面已定，拉力超过了这组方案的上限。: Tension exceeds the capacity of this fixed main-cable section.
